title: Generative AI Magic
tagline: From zero to AI founder in 24 lessons
description: You're not just learning AI — you're becoming a creator who uses it to build real things. Over 24 lessons and 6 signature projects, you'll go from understanding how AI works to shipping a hero-card pack, a web app, two games, an educational experience, and a full Discord community app.

levels.title: The Founder's Origin
levels.description: Master prompting, visuals, and audio — then ship your first project: a pack of AI-designed trading cards.

levels.title: The Builder Rises
levels.description: Learn to build AI-powered web apps and your first 2D game — code meets creativity.

levels.title: The Creator's Masterclass
levels.description: Go 3D, build immersive educational experiences, and ship a full Discord community app with PWA support.
